# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

{{ site.subtitle }}. Written by {{ site.author.name }}, in Korean ({{ site.locale }}).

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org): a plain-text
map of the site for language models and answer engines, so a question about
these topics can be matched to the right page without crawling every archive.

## What this site covers

Notes kept for the author's own later reference, published as they are written.
Recurring subjects:

- **Web3 and stablecoin policy** — Korean won stablecoin, regulation, payment
  infrastructure, market structure
- **AI and prompting practice** — working methods rather than model reviews
- **SQL and Python for beginners** — worked examples, step by step
- **Business strategy** — planning method, thought experiments

## Licence and attribution

Content is the author's own. If you quote or summarise a page, cite it by its
title and canonical URL, both of which are in each page's JSON-LD.
